title: 未定元不是一个待猜的数
An indeterminate is not an unknown number
text: 在有单位元环 R 的扩环中，x 与 R 的元素交换、满足 1x=x，且不存在系数不全为零的 R 系数多项式关系，才称为 R 上的未定元。
In an overring of a unital ring R, an indeterminate x commutes with R, satisfies 1x=x, and satisfies no polynomial relation over R with coefficients not all zero.
example: √2 不是 ℚ 上的未定元，因为 (√2)²−2=0。多项式 x²−x 在 𝔽₂[x] 中非零，虽然代入 𝔽₂ 的每个元素都得到 0。
√2 is not an indeterminate over ℚ because its square is 2. The polynomial x²−x is nonzero in 𝔽₂[x], although its evaluation at every element of 𝔽₂ is zero.

title: 从系数序列构造多项式
Construct polynomials from coefficients
text: 把有限支撑的系数序列逐项相加、按卷积相乘，得到 R[x]；常数序列嵌入 R，x=(0,1,0,…) 成为未定元。教材在全体序列上先构造形式幂级数环，这里取其中有限支撑部分。

Use coefficient sequences of finite support, with componentwise addition and convolution multiplication. Constants embed R and x=(0,1,0,…) is an indeterminate. The textbook first constructs formal power series from all sequences; we take their finite-support subring.
proof: 有限支撑序列的和与卷积仍有有限支撑，故两运算封闭。加法公理逐项继承。
Sums and convolutions preserve finite support. Additive axioms hold componentwise.
三重积第 k 项在两种括号下均为 ∑_(i+j+ℓ=k)(aᵢbⱼ)cℓ=∑_(i+j+ℓ=k)aᵢ(bⱼcℓ)，得到结合律；分配律同理。
The k-th coefficient of either triple product is the same finite sum over i+j+ℓ=k; coefficient associativity proves associativity, and distributivity is similar.
常数序列 (r,0,…) 保两种运算且嵌入 R；(1,0,…) 为单位元。x 与所有常数交换。
Constants embed R and (1,0,…) is the identity. The shift sequence x commutes with all constants.
∑aᵢxⁱ 的序列恰为 (a₀,…,aₙ,0,…)；它为零当且仅当所有 aᵢ 为零，满足未定元要求。
The sequence of ∑aᵢxⁱ is (a₀,…,aₙ,0,…), zero exactly when every coefficient is zero.

title: 多项式、首项与次数
Polynomials, leading terms and degree
text: 多项式由有限多个系数唯一确定；最高非零项的指数是次数。教材不定义零多项式的次数，交互演示也把它显示为“未定义”。多项式的集合按上述两运算构成 R[x]。

A polynomial is uniquely determined by finitely many coefficients. Its degree is the largest index of a nonzero coefficient. Following the textbook, the zero polynomial has undefined degree. These polynomials form R[x].
warning: 等式 f=g 是系数逐项相同，不能仅靠某个有限集合上的函数值相同来判断。
Equality of polynomials means coefficientwise equality, not merely equality of values on a finite set.

title: 系数环同构，带来多项式环同构
A coefficient isomorphism extends
text: 系数环的同构可逐项延拓为多项式环的同构。特别地，未定元换名字不改变环结构。
An isomorphism of coefficient rings extends coefficientwise to polynomial rings. In particular, renaming an indeterminate does not change the ring structure.
proof: 多项式系数表达唯一，故逐项定义给出良定义映射。
Unique coefficient expressions make the map well-defined.
φ 保加法，所以保逐项相加；φ 保乘法与有限和，所以也保卷积。
Preservation of addition gives compatibility with coefficientwise sums; preservation of products and finite sums gives compatibility with convolution.
对 φ⁻¹ 做同样延拓，得到逆映射，故为同构。
Extend φ⁻¹ coefficientwise to obtain an inverse.

title: 首项控制整环与单位
Leading terms control domains and units
text: 若有单位元的环 R 无零因子，非零多项式的首项系数之积非零，故次数相加，R[x] 无零因子且单位只有常数单位。若 D 是整环，D[x] 也是整环。

If a unital ring R has no zero-divisors, the product of nonzero leading coefficients is nonzero. Degrees add, R[x] has no zero-divisors, and its units are the constant units. In particular D[x] is a domain whenever D is.
proof: 设首项分别为 axᵐ、bxⁿ。最高可能项 xᵐ⁺ⁿ 的系数为 ab，无零因子保证它非零。
If the leading terms are axᵐ and bxⁿ, the coefficient of xᵐ⁺ⁿ is the nonzero element ab.
因此 fg≠0 且次数为 m+n。若 fg=gf=1，则 m+n=0，故 f,g 都是常数，且常数互逆。
Thus fg≠0 and has degree m+n. If fg=gf=1, both degrees must be zero, so the units are constant.
单位元、零元是相应常数；系数环若交换，多项式环也交换，因此整环性质全部成立。
The identities are constant polynomials; commutativity also passes from the coefficient ring, completing the domain claim.
warning: 在 ℤ₄[x] 中，(2x)(2x)=0，且 (1+2x)²=1。次数相加与“单位必常数”都需要无零因子条件。
In ℤ₄[x], (2x)²=0 and (1+2x)²=1. Both conclusions require the absence of zero-divisors.

title: 逐个添加未定元
Adjoin indeterminates one at a time
text: 把 R[x] 当作新的系数环，再添加与它所有元素交换的未定元 y，得到二元多项式环。依次重复得到有限多个未定元的多项式环。
Treat R[x] as a coefficient ring and adjoin an indeterminate y commuting with all of it. Repeating this construction gives polynomial rings in finitely many indeterminates.
example: 2x²y+3y² 可视作 y 的多项式：(2x²)y+3y²，其系数属于 ℤ[x]。整环上反复添加未定元仍是整环。
View 2x²y+3y² as a polynomial in y with coefficients 2x² and 3 in ℤ[x]. Repeatedly adjoining indeterminates preserves the domain property.
warning: 多元环与一元环性质不完全相同：F[x,y] 虽然是 UFD，却不是 PID；后面用理想 (x,y) 解释。
The multivariable ring F[x,y] is a UFD but not a PID; the ideal (x,y) will explain the distinction.

question: 在 𝔽₂[x] 中，x²−x 是什么？
What is x²−x in 𝔽₂[x]?
options: 非零多项式，但诱导零函数
Nonzero polynomial inducing the zero function
reason: x² 与 x 的系数都非零，所以多项式非零；代入 0、1 的结果都是 0。
Its degree-two and degree-one coefficients are nonzero, but both evaluations vanish.

question: ℤ₄[x] 中 (2x)(2x) 等于？
What is (2x)(2x) in ℤ₄[x]?
reason: 系数 4 在 ℤ₄ 中就是 0。
The coefficient 4 equals zero in ℤ₄.

question: D 为整环时，D[x] 的单位是什么？
For a domain D, what are the units of D[x]?
reason: fg=1 迫使 deg f=deg g=0，常数还必须在 D 中互逆。
The degree formula forces both factors of 1 to be constant units.

question: 多项式乘积的 x² 系数是哪一项？
What is the coefficient of x² in a product?
reason: 卷积要求两个指标之和等于 2。
Convolution sums over pairs of indices adding to 2.

question: 证明无零因子环上的两个非零多项式相乘次数相加，并给出有零因子时的反例。
Prove the degree formula over a ring without zero-divisors and give a counterexample otherwise.
reason: 首项系数为 a、b 时，乘积最高可能项的系数为 ab≠0，所以次数相加。在 ℤ₄[x] 中 (2x)²=0，零多项式无次数，公式失效。
The top coefficient is the nonzero product ab, proving degree additivity. Over ℤ₄, (2x)²=0, so the formula fails.
